english.title: Attempt to use a time dependent tram ticket on the Croydon Tramlink system outside of the applicable time constraints
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to make use of a Croydon Tramlink ticket, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TICKET..), purchased at a reduced fare outside the time constraints applicable to that ticket, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TIME CONSTRAINTS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 24(2), 30 and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
